settings.name: webhook_secret
settings.label: Webhook signing secret
settings.help: whsec_… from Stripe Dashboard → Webhooks (see stripe/docs/stripe_checklist.md)

settings.name: success_link
settings.label: Checkout success
settings.help: Where to send the buyer after a successful Checkout (cart order or subscription), e.g. an Order received page.||Empty: cart orders go to the site home; subscriptions to home with ?subscription_checkout=success (or pricing resume).

settings.name: cancel_link
settings.label: Checkout cancel
settings.help: Where to send the buyer who cancels Checkout. The cart stays as it was.||Empty: cart orders go to the site home; subscriptions resume the pricing page or home with ?subscription_checkout=cancel.

settings.name: shipping_countries
settings.label: Delivery countries
settings.help: Cart checkout: countries Stripe accepts for the delivery address, as comma-separated ISO codes (GB, IE, FR, …).

settings.name: terms_consent
settings.label: Require terms acceptance
settings.help: Yes: the buyer must tick that they agree to the terms before paying.||First set the Terms of service URL in Stripe Dashboard → Settings → Public details: without it Stripe refuses the checkout.

settings.name: terms_link
settings.label: Terms page
settings.help: The site's terms and conditions of sale page, linked from the tickbox text ({{terms_url}}).

settings.name: terms_text
settings.label: Terms tickbox text
settings.default: I agree to the [terms and conditions of sale]({{terms_url}}).
settings.help: Next to the tickbox when terms acceptance is required. Markdown link; {{terms_url}} = the Terms page. Max 1200 characters.

settings.name: submit_text
settings.label: Note under Pay
settings.help: Optional short text Stripe shows under the Pay button. Empty: none. Max 1200 characters.

settings.name: notify_technical
settings.label: Technical email
settings.help: Uses Site settings → Technical admin email (admin_email) when set.

settings.name: notification_emails
settings.label: Extra notification emails
settings.help: Additional addresses for all Stripe webhook events we handle
